usage.title: How to use
usage.description:
[CU stores]
Present the mobile gift card barcode when paying
(Can be used just like cash or a card at CU stores nationwide)

notice.title: Usage information
descriptions: It can be used just like cash or a card at CU stores nationwide.
It can be combined with cash, a card, or other payment methods.
Mobile carrier discount cards can be applied.
CU mobile gift cards support balance tracking and can be used in installments within the remaining balance.
A cash receipt can be issued.
For balance and usage history inquiries: Galaxia Communications customer center, 1566-0123

refund.title: Changes and cancellation
refund.description: If the voucher has not been used, you can receive a 100% refund within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period has passed or if the voucher has been partially used.

caution.title: Precautions
descriptions: The exchange validity period is 60 days.
It cannot be combined with other coupons, and points cannot be earned.
Restricted items: cigarettes, lottery tickets, garbage bags, T-money top-ups, parcel delivery, and other service products
